national_news.title: PM Modi Inaugurates Pune Metro Line 3 and Lays Foundation for Phase-II Projects
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated Pune Metro Line 3 (Pink Line), built at a cost of over ₹8,300 crore, spanning 23 km from Maan to District Court Metro station.
Laid the foundation stone for Pune Metro Phase-II, estimated at ₹13,500 crore, encompassing Lines 2A, 2B, 4, and 4A to expand connectivity across residential and IT hubs.
Line 3 features a first-of-its-kind initiative operated entirely by women train operators and aims to meet 30% of its electricity requirement through solar power.

national_news.title: India Tops Pool Stage at Hero Asian Champions Trophy 2026 Hockey
bullets: The Indian Men's Hockey Team completed an unbeaten pool-stage run at the Hero Asian Champions Trophy 2026 in Jalandhar, finishing top with 15 points and a +29 goal difference.
India defeated Korea 8-0 in their final pool match, setting up a semi-final clash against the same opponent in Mohali.
Harmanpreet Singh topped the tournament scoring chart with nine goals at the conclusion of the league phase.

national_news.title: Bhutan Dedicates Sacred Stupa 76 to PM Modi in Gelephu Mindfulness City
bullets: The King of Bhutan dedicated Stupa number 76 to Prime Minister Narendra Modi during the consecration of 108 Stupas in Gelephu Mindfulness City along the Aie (Mau) River.
Union Minority Affairs Minister Kiren Rijiju represented India at the ceremony held on the auspicious occasion of Lhabab Duchen near the Assam border.
The 108 Stupas project (each 15 meters tall over an 11.7 km stretch) aims to establish Gelephu Mindfulness City as a prominent center for Vajrayana Buddhism.

national_news.title: Union Home Ministry to Establish FRROs in All State Capitals by 2027
bullets: Union Home Minister Amit Shah directed the establishment of Foreigners Regional Registration Offices (FRROs) in all state capitals by 2027, expanding from the current 20 states.
The Central government is pursuing setting up FRROs in remaining states including Bihar, Goa, Himachal Pradesh, Jharkhand, Madhya Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, and Meghalaya.
FRROs manage post-arrival registration, regulate and track foreign nationals, and provide consular services such as visa extensions, conversions, and legal safety.

national_news.title: PM Modi Inaugurates Bharat Renewable Energy Summit and Expo 2026
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the four-day Bharat Renewable Energy Summit and Expo 2026 at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, organized under the theme 'Invest. Innovate. Inspire.'
India's non-fossil fuel-based installed capacity crossed 310 GW—accounting for over 50% of total installed power capacity—towards the target of achieving 500 GW.
The renewable energy sector attracted $67 billion in total investments and $6.2 billion in FDI over the past two years, with PM-KUSUM benefiting over 30 lakh farmers with solar irrigation.

national_news.title: India and EU Review Implementation Timeline for Bilateral Free Trade Agreement
bullets: Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal held high-level discussions in Brussels with European Commission officials regarding preparations for implementing the India-EU Free Trade Agreement (FTA).

The proposed FTA eliminates tariffs on over 99% of Indian exports to the EU and reduces duties on over 96% of European goods, including a phased tariff reduction on automobiles to 10% under an annual quota of 250,000 units.
The agreement negotiations concluded at the 16th India-EU Summit in January 2026, with proposed signing in mid-December 2026 and target entry into force by mid-2027.

national_news.title: India and European Union Discuss FTA Implementation and Customs Cooperation in Brussels
bullets: Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal held high-level meetings in Brussels with European Commission Directorates-General (Trade, International Partnerships, and Taxation & Customs Union) to review Free Trade Agreement (FTA) implementation and trade facilitation.

Under the proposed India-EU FTA, tariffs will be eliminated on over 99% of Indian exports (benefiting textiles, leather, and jewellery), while India will reduce duties on over 96% of EU goods, including phased auto tariff cuts to 10% under a quota of 250,000 units.
Following the conclusion of FTA negotiations at the 16th India-EU Summit in January 2026, the agreement is targeted for signing in mid-December 2026 and full entry into force by mid-2027.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Couple Establishes Micro Food Processing Unit under PMFME Scheme
bullets: Ranjana Kumari and Sanjay Kumar from Sheikhpura district, Bihar, established 'Smriti Noodles' under the Pradhan Mantri Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME) scheme.
The food processing venture received government financial assistance to set up machinery, creating regular local employment for over 10 people and supplying products to nearby districts like Nalanda.

The PMFME scheme, a centrally sponsored initiative under the Ministry of Food Processing Industries, provides financial, technical, and business support for upgrading micro food processing enterprises.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Appeals to High-Income Consumers to Surrender Electricity Subsidy
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary appealed to income tax payers and affluent families to voluntarily give up the benefit of 125 units of free electricity.
The Bihar state government incurs an annual expenditure of approximately ₹23,000 crore on power subsidies, costing between ₹8,000 and ₹10,000 per household.
The appeal was made during the 'Pataliputra National Youth Parliament 2.0' in Patna to save state revenue for developmental projects.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Govt Transfers ₹68.51 Crore to Over 1 Lakh Dairy Farmers via DBT
bullets: The Bihar government transferred ₹68.51 crore directly into the bank accounts of 106,063 dairy farmers linked across 5,832 milk-producer cooperative societies.
Inaugurated the 'Sudha Sampark' call centre to address livestock-related queries and an Integrated Command and Control Centre (ICCC) for monitoring milk supply in real-time.
The dairy operations are executed by the Bihar State Milk Co-operative Federation (COMFED), which markets dairy products under the 'Sudha' brand.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Govt Urges Income Tax Payers to Surrender 125 Units Free Power
bullets: Bihar CM Samrat Choudhary urged tax-paying residents to relinquish their entitlement to 125 units of subsidised power to optimize state development spending.
The state government allocates ₹23,000 crore each year for power subsidies, benefiting all household income groups uniformly.
The voluntarily surrendered subsidy amount is intended to be redirected towards nation-building and youth empowerment initiatives.

bihar_news.title: EAM S Jaishankar Reviews India-US Diplomatic Ties with Consuls General in Atlanta
bullets: External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar held a bilateral review meeting in Atlanta with eight Indian Consuls General serving across the United States.

The high-level meeting was attended by Indian Ambassador to the US Vinay Mohan Kwatra and MEA Additional Secretary (Americas and Canada) K Nagraj Naidu to discuss trade, innovation, and educational ties.
India currently operates eight diplomatic Consulates General in the US: New York, Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, San Francisco, Houston, Seattle, and Los Angeles.
